row.team_price_text: SEO: $117.33/mo billed annually (one user seat; additional users from $45/mo)
row.evidence: Semrush's pricing page lists "SSO, team governance & audit logs" only under Semrush for Enterprise ("Custom pricing available"), and its knowledge base documents SAML 2.0 SSO set up by the Semrush team with users invited manually; no SCIM is documented.
row.notes: No SCIM. Self-serve SEO + AI Search plans are priced per account with one user seat (SEO $117.33, Starter $165.17, Pro+ $248.17, Advanced $455.67 per month billed annually; $139/$199/$299/$549 monthly); extra users are an add-on starting at $45/mo, so no per-user figure is recorded. SAML SSO: the pricing page puts it under Semrush for Enterprise (custom pricing), while the SSO help article says it is available to Guru and Business users (legacy plan names). SSO is configured by the Semrush team on request with a domain/email allowlist; users must already be registered. The Okta OIN app is SWA only. Semrush APIs are data APIs with no user management.

plans.name: SEO
plans.notes: One user seat included; extra users from $45/mo.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Includes API data integration (SEO data, not user management).

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented. Users are invited by the owner/admins after buying seats; SAML SSO is set up by the Semrush team on request.

limitations.text: Semrush APIs cover SEO, Trends, Projects (folders, campaigns) and Local data; no user, seat or team-management endpoints are documented.

okta.notes: OIN 'SEMrush' app marks SWA only (read from page markup).

entra.notes: No Semrush entry in the Microsoft Entra SaaS app tutorial index (toc.json).

open_questions: Whether SAML sign-in creates users just-in-time is unclear: the SSO article mentions 'user creation' but also says users must already be registered.
Whether Semrush for Enterprise (a separate product) offers SCIM is not documented publicly.
Whether Guru/Business legacy subscribers still get SSO without Enterprise is not stated on the pricing page.
